architecturalElements.credits.body:
MUSEUM WITH NO FRONTIERS **\[MWNF\]**  
*ARCHITECTURAL ELEMENTS* VIRTUAL MUSEUM  
(Provisional list, updated April 2020)  
  
  
**NOTE**  
For now, in this Gallery you will find artefacts related to *Architectural Elements* from other MWNF databases, namely [Discover Islamic Art](https://islamicart.museumwnf.org/), [Discover Baroque Art](https://baroqueart.museumwnf.org/) and [Sharing History](https://sharinghistory.museumwnf.org/)... **MWNF TEAM**  
Eva SCHUBERT (idea and overall coordination)  
Sarah HOENIGSCHNABEL (content management, upload)  
Pascal HAVELANGE (database maintenance, application program interface)  
Eva WOO (web development, navigation and design updates)

gallery.about.body:
Welcome to MWNF Galleries!  
  
Each Gallery focuses on a specific medium, which means a specific material or type of object. This Gallery is dedicated to **Architectural Elements**.  
  
...We suggest you start your visit in the [Collection](https://architectural-elements.museumwnf.org/collection)... the [Partner](https://architectural-elements.museumwnf.org/partners) section... the [Timeline](https://architectural-elements.museumwnf.org/timeline)... [My Collection](https://www.museumwnf.org/mycollection/index.php)... [here](https://www.museumwnf.org/database_searchform.php) or go to the above-mentioned projects to search their databases.
